title: what I've learned creating better vlogs & how I edit for youtube — Dani Lee
technique: Build the narrative from key scenes before adding connective footage

moments.observation: Automatic captions describe editing the main talking scenes first to keep the vlog aligned with its theme.
Automatic captions describe B-roll between key scenes and showing experiences rather than only describing them.

takeaway: Choose the scenes carrying the message, then add relevant connective footage where it clarifies the experience.
useWhen: A vlog has several substantive scenes and relevant supporting footage.
avoidWhen: Supporting footage is absent or would imply something untrue.
